glossary.ja: ペンタゴナ・ワールド
glossary.role: The five-planet Pentagona system where L-Gaim is set.
Self-evolving, self-repairing, self-replicating rogue Gundam (JDG-00X); main antagonist machine of G Gundam
Gigantic sentient alien ship buried under the Pacific; its awakening threatens Earth; base of the Reclaimers

Emperor ruling the Pentagona World from Sveto on Gastogal; supreme commander of the Poseidal Army. The Poseidal on the throne is actually Mian Qu Ha Ussher, a puppet of the true Poseidal (Amandara Kamandara). In ACE2 'Poseidal' is the pilot of the Aug.
glossary.personality: Regal, cold and imperious ruler who controls others (e.g. Quwasan) through the bio-relation system; her memories are themselves manipulated, and she finally turns against Amandara.

glossary.role: Domon's older brother and a Neo Japan scientist; co-developer of the Ultimate Gundam, later the Devil Gundam's core unit.
glossary.personality: Kind and gentle; loves his younger brother and taught him to have faith in others.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: SDF-1 Macross, the U.N. Spacy super-dimensional fortress (human flagship).
Seat no. 3 and de facto leader of Poseidal's Thirteen, the highest-ranking officer after Poseidal; rebels against Poseidal with his own fleet (the Giwaza fleet) and is killed in the final battle.
glossary.personality: Capable, cold, calculating and ambitious; uses and discards people, including his lover Nei Mo Han; a political schemer.

36.speaker: Lucrezia Noin
36.role: tactical staff officer (特尉, Special Lieutenant) from the Preventer
36.evidence: m6112#36 Sinapus: 'ノイン特尉、後で詳しく聞かせてくれ' then p36 explains Domon in brief63178#4-9; commanding but female, do not masculinize

report.translator_summary: Translated all 80 rows of op23_03, covering the space battle conclusion against Giwaza Lowau, the destruction of his flagship, Noin's tactical briefing on Earth descent, and the terrestrial showdown where Domon unleashes the God Finger and Sekiha Tenkyoken against the Devil Gundam, followed by the Macross's sudden return.
